source.why: The only Karman originals in the repo. A read-only count of the live question bank on 2026-11-01 found 9,780 live rows and every one of them carries a source_pdf (exam forms such as original_exam.pdf, 202506usv1.pdf), so no live bank row qualifies as a Karman original under design rule 45.
source.shape: Each original is mapped to the quiz engine's row shape (QuizQuestionWithChoices) without changing a word: the 'A) ' prefix is stripped from choices the way the diagnostic's own AnswerChoiceButton does, craft-4's 'Text 1 / Text 2' passage is split into the engine's passage_a and passage_b, topic_cluster comes from CLUSTER_BY_DOMAIN and node_id from the curriculum node with the same concept_slug.

states.question: Fresh screen, nothing chosen. PNG + WebP, phone 440 and desktop 1200, light and dark.
states.correct-explain: The right answer chosen, Submit Answer pressed, Show explanations open, the question panel scrolled into view. PNG + WebP, all four device and mode combinations.
states.wrong: A wrong answer chosen and submitted: the chosen choice in the error tint, the right one marked with a check, Show explanations still closed. PNG + WebP, all four combinations.
states.selected: The right answer chosen, Submit Answer visible, not yet submitted. WebP, dark only, both devices.
states.tools: Scratch pad open with a pen stroke (resized and moved on desktop the way a student would), a highlight on the passage for Reading and Writing, timer showing. WebP, dark only, both devices.
states.guide: The Questions guide (the set indicator) open over the question. WebP, dark only, both devices.
